title: The unsigned tensor bicomplex and its maps
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and P,Q be N-indexed chain complexes of R-modules [def-weil-pbc-chain-complex-tensor-module]. Define A(P,Q) [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] by A(p,q)=P_p tensor_R Q_q, horizontal differential d_P tensor 1 and vertical differential 1 tensor d_Q. The differentials square to zero and commute. For chain maps a:P→P' and b:Q→Q', define A(a,b) termwise by a_p tensor b_q. Also define chainTensorMap(a,g) for a module map g:N→N' as the chain map P tensor N→P' tensor N' with components a_p tensor g.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00M3 (lemma-tor-left-right), proof: tensor double complex, cokernel-complex computations and functoriality paragraph; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00M3

proof.text: Reuse the retained upstream HomologicalComplex₂.tensorBicomplex and tensorBicomplexMap from WeilConjectures.Algebra.Homology.TensorBicomplexExtension. They are the same transparent abbreviations of Mathlib Functor.mapBifunctorHomologicalComplex and its uncurried map. For tensoring a chain map with a module map, use ChainComplex.tensorMap from the extension's publicly imported WeilConjectures.Algebra.Homology.TensorBicomplex. Its mapHomologicalComplex/NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex composite is exactly the former chainTensorMap construction. The current library has no import of Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.TensorBicomplex, so withdraw this duplicate without changing upstream declarations or consumers.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00M3 (lemma-tor-left-right), tensor double complex and functoriality paragraphs; reuse the existing upstream Mathlib aliases and ChainComplex.tensorMap.
